title: capture-reference-intermission-finale

captureContract.captureMode: Passive attract-loop sampling via the canonical 12-step GDI BitBlt/GetDIBits pipeline against the sandboxed Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 SDL window with no user input; the runner spawns DOOM.EXE clean, waits for the visible window, then walks the ATTRACT_LOOP_CHECKPOINTS contract sleeping until each scheduledAtElapsedMs target before capturing the live BGRA framebuffer + 320x200 normalized buffer.
captureContract.liveCaptureGate: test/plan_final/oracle/capture-reference-intermission-finale.test.ts unconditionally pins the static surface (runner + normalizer + ATTRACT_LOOP_PHASES + ATTRACT_LOOP_CHECKPOINTS + override key set + error class shape), and gates the live capture on every REFERENCE_SANDBOX_POLICY.requiredFiles entry being present; when gated in, the live test spawns a fresh sandboxed DOOM.EXE, walks the 4-checkpoint attract-loop schedule (3s → 9s → 18s → 30s), captures the BGRA + 320x200 framebuffers, and asserts ordered timestamps + valid sha256 hashes per checkpoint.

scopeNote: MVP runner samples the passive attract-loop only (title → DEMO1 → post-DEMO1 interstitial). Scripted intermission gameplay capture (E1M1 exit switch walk per capture-scripted-intermission-path.json) and finale capture (E1M8 boss exit per shareware episode end) remain deferred to follow-up oracle work that needs longer test budgets and more robust scripted-input timing.
